title: One Book Before Bed
can_do: 在明确的睡前边界内，请求一件可以完成的小事。

conversation_move.label: request one thing before a boundary

trigger: Mom says there is time for one short activity before lights out.
core_response: Can we read a book before bed?
stretch_response: Can we read the blue bear book before bed?

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: We have time for one thing before lights out.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Can we read the bear book before bed?

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Yes, one short book. Which bear book?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: The blue one, please. It has the sleepy bear.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Here it is. We will read it, then lights out.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Okay. I am ready for our story.

replay_cards.title: One goodnight song
replay_cards.change: There is time for one short song
replay_cards.challenge: Request one named song, sing it together, then turn out the light

replay_cards.title: Choose tomorrow's shirt
replay_cards.change: Two shirts are already on the chair
replay_cards.challenge: Ask to choose one now, identify it, set it aside, and continue bedtime

parent_support: State the real limit before inviting the request.
Honor the agreed short activity, then keep the bedtime boundary calmly.
